body.message:
We will be happy to assist you with moving your booking to the studio apartment.

Regarding the refund, kindly allow us a little time to process it. As it is already 3:00 PM and today is Friday, arranging a cash refund today may be challenging. Since your payment was made by card, we can proceed with refunding the amount back to the same card, if that works for you.

In the meantime, we will inform the Bayz team that you will be arriving shortly for your check-in to the studio, so everything will be ready for you.

Thank you very much for your understanding and cooperation—we truly appreciate it.
